description: Deep Stress Relief Music | Santoor & Tanpura | 3 Hours — let the whole evening unwind.
Three hours of slow, resonant santoor over a rich tanpura drone. Nothing to follow, nothing sudden — a deep, warm bed of sound for the end of a long day, from dinner to lights-out.
🎧 HOW TO USE — low volume from the evening onward. Loops seamlessly; long enough that you never touch it.
⏱ BEST FOR — releasing the day's stress · evening wind-down · after-work decompression · deep rest
🎵 ABOUT — the santoor's hundred strings, played slowly, ring like soft rain; over tanpura it becomes weightless.
